name: OpenScience
description: Research agent with a workbench of shell, Python and R kernels and notebooks that plans tasks, runs experiments and reports checkable results.
whatItDoes: Takes a research task described in plain language, gathers evidence, executes code and experiments, and returns results you can verify. It serves scientists and analysts working from a terminal or desktop app.
howItWorks: A CLI and desktop application run an agent loop with access to a shell, language kernels and notebooks, and can attach MCP servers. Models are connected by adding your own key, signing in to a provider, pointing at a local endpoint or using the vendor's managed option.

requirements.name: Model access
requirements.description: Own provider key, provider sign-in, local endpoint such as Ollama, or the managed plan

run: openscience run "Review the analysis plan in this project"
models: Bring-your-own provider, local models (Ollama, LM Studio) or managed option
